meta.title: Javi · A life in milestones
meta.description: Javi's life from 1980 to today as a sky of memories, with a book for his children and the Echo to keep talking with him. Join a waitlist.

guide.title: How to read this sky
guide.cloud: A cloud is a memory; the bigger it is, the more it changed
guide.galaxy: A dotted circle is one age of my life, cut at {ages}; time runs from its core to its rim
guide.ring: A hollow ring is still ahead: the book and the Echo
guide.dust: The fine dust is the days, thicker where more happened
guide.keys: / find · ? this guide · H only the sky · Esc back

hero.title: A life, in milestones.
hero.lede: I'm Javi. This is my life from 1980 to today: a cloud of dots per memory, a galaxy per age. Explore it as you like. Ahead: a book for my children, and the Echo, my voice for those who want to keep talking with me.

early.name: Early years
early.title: Early years.
early.intro: From birth to the day I turned seven.

book.hint: Everything I learned, written down for my children. Not out yet.
book.title: A book for my children.
book.body: It's for my children, and for anyone who wants it: my life, what I've learnt, what went well and what went wrong. Leave your email and I'll write to you when it's out.

clone.disclosure: It is a program built from what I wrote; it is not me.

clone.title: A place to keep talking.
clone.body: I'm building the Echo, a version of me for whoever wants to keep talking with me when I'm no longer here, especially those who knew me. It isn't ready yet.
